title: Kmt2b loss produces a thalamic, mostly downregulated neuronal program
exact_observed_result: Kmt2b was significantly reduced in both 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut, but the 151 class converted similar target depletion into a 46-gene, mostly downregulated program led by Stxbp2, Rasgrp2, Csf2ra, Adamts3, and Fah.
biological_interpretation: Neuronal KMT2B suppression acts as a loss-like state and identifies thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c neurons as more transcriptionally vulnerable than similarly engaged midbrain glutamatergic neurons.
cell_types: 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut

evidence_records.statistics: Kmt2b was measured in 23 cell types; transcript logFC was negative in 22/23 with median -0.316. Only 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut reached on-target FDR <0.05: -0.659, FDR 1.72e-7, 230 perturbed versus 23,679 controls; and -0.584, FDR 0.0332, 170 perturbed versus 20,353 controls. Six cell types had nominal Kmt2b p<0.005.
evidence_records.description: Aggregate on-target transcript engagement for the Kmt2b perturbation across assayed cell types.

evidence_records.statistics: 230 perturbed cells versus 23,679 controls; 46 genes at FDR <=0.05, 44 down and 2 up. Kmt2b ranked fifth by negative score: logFC -0.659, FDR 1.72e-7. Top down effects were Stxbp2 logFC -1.578, FDR 9.53e-25; Rasgrp2 -1.659, FDR 8.24e-15; Csf2ra -0.869, FDR 3.25e-8; Adamts3 -0.800, FDR 8.01e-8; Echdc2 -1.355, FDR 4.53e-7; Fah -0.690, FDR 5.36e-7. The two FDR<=0.05 up genes were Hap1 logFC 0.612, FDR 0.00386 and Sptbn1 0.180, FDR 0.0187.
evidence_records.description: The dominant Kmt2b transcriptional response concentrated in posterior thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic neurons and was mostly downregulated.

evidence_records.statistics: 170 perturbed cells versus 20,353 controls; Kmt2b logFC -0.584, FDR 0.0332. Four genes reached FDR <=0.05 and all were down: Ebf4 logFC -1.416, FDR 1.17e-6; Csf2ra -0.903, FDR 1.16e-4; Fah -1.017, FDR 0.00210; Kmt2b -0.584, FDR 0.0332. The top positive genes Dtnb and Pnck had FDR 0.656.
evidence_records.description: Midbrain glutamatergic cells showed on-target Kmt2b transcript depletion with a small downstream signature.

caveats: The recurrent marker panel outside 151 TH is weaker and partially overlapping rather than a single shared pan-neuronal module.

prior_expectation.summary: Prior literature and pathway context were taken from the resolved report references; the observed Perturb-seq signal either refines expected gene function by cell type or marks an exploratory response-state neighbor where noted in caveats.
